title: Listening practice
subtitle: A2 · Unit 10: Food, shopping and quantities

steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.fr: Je prends un sachet de lentilles et deux barquettes de fraises. Le prix des fraises est au kilo.
steps.question: How many strawberry punnets does the speaker take?

steps.fr: Du lait végétal ? J'en prends un litre. La boisson sans sucre reste au magasin.
steps.question: How much plant-based milk does the speaker take?
steps.explain: The quantity kept after en is un litre.

steps.fr: Le plat préparé ne convient pas à mon régime. Je vais en choisir un autre.
steps.question: Why does the speaker choose another dish?
options: The prepared dish does not suit the diet
The price per kilogram is missing
steps.explain: The speaker says the prepared dish does not suit the diet.

steps.fr: Il reste une moitié de la sauce. Nous en gardons une moitié pour demain.
steps.question: How much sauce will the group keep?
steps.explain: The speaker says they will keep half.

steps.fr: Le produit est en promotion, mais la date de péremption est demain.
steps.question: What should the shopper notice about the product?
options: Its price per kilogram is missing
steps.explain: The recording says the best-before date is tomorrow.
